label: EXAMPLE — NOT A RESULT: preregistration only; contains no performance figure

common.bars: daily, unadjusted OHLC with separately verified corporate actions
common.execution: signal at close t, fill at open t+1
common.rebalance: first session of each calendar month unless the configuration says otherwise
common.asset_vol: EWMA of daily log returns, span 60 sessions, rows <= t only
common.eligibility: an instrument is eligible once every row its lookback needs exists; no pre-listing backfill
common.costs: spec 046 model: half of the EDGE full-spread estimate (Ardia-Guidotti-Kroencke 2024; bidask v2.1.0 algorithm; negative S^2 -> sqrt(|S^2|)) plus square-root impact Y=1.0, 21-session windows
common.cv: purged and embargoed walk-forward inside the research window; embargo >= longest lookback

configurations.rule: time-series momentum: hold assets whose return from close[t-21*3] to close[t-21] is > 0; inverse-vol weights
trend filter: hold assets with close[t] > SMA(close, 100); inverse-vol weights
cross-asset momentum: equal weight the top k by return close[t-252] to close[t-21]
inverse-volatility risk parity over all eligible assets, always invested
H4 weights restricted to assets with a positive H1-12 signal
dual momentum: the single highest total return over the lookback among non-SHY assets, held only if it beats SHY's return, otherwise hold SHY
low volatility: equal weight the 3 sector ETFs (XL*) with the lowest 60-session realized volatility
short-term reversal: equal weight the 3 sector ETFs with the lowest prior 5-session return; rebalance on the first session of each week
equal-weight blend of H1-12, H2-200 and H4 target weights
60/40 SPY/IEF, rebalanced monthly; no vol targeting

baselines.rule: equal weight of eligible universe, rebalanced monthly
seeded random long/flat per asset, monthly, same sizing and costs

selection_rule: highest research-window DSR at N_family; ties go to the lower configuration order above
holdout_pass: D-4: holdout net Sharpe > 0 and one-sided HAC t >= 1.645, and research-window Gate 3 per spec 033
voiding: any breach of spec 058 D-1 (a)-(d), or more than n_family_cap candidate starts, reverts this family to lifetime N
